The way the attribute should work is when it is modified the current records sets the ObsoleteDate value to now or if overriden to a future date.  The new record then gets the effective date filled in with the current date or future date so that it swaps over at the precise time the old record is obsolete.  This way if I have material coming in a future date that is different it doesn't take effect until after it arrives.  Most of the time this will just be the current date.
